name: Gyan
intro: I really like to discover and build. That's why, instead of calling an API, I built a language model from scratch — every layer, the tokenizer, the training loop, all of it, on my own laptop.
now: Right now my studies come first: I'm preparing for JEE-Mains to get into college next year. Building happens around them — one project, one experiment at a time.

strong.name: Python
strong.note: my best language — Aizen is built with it

strong.name: HTML & CSS
strong.note: most of my apps and games ship with it

journey.title: First contact
journey.detail: Started coding in 7th class — and honestly, didn't like it. Writing programs felt like a chore, and I drifted away.

journey.title: The comeback
journey.detail: Years later I tried again — and this time it clicked. I became genuinely fond of building things, and the journey properly started.

journey.title: Building in public
journey.detail: One project at a time: games, study timers, a prompt library, an AR experiment, a 3D AI assistant — 11 projects, each one teaching something new.

journey.title: Aizen
journey.detail: The big one — a language model built completely from scratch in PyTorch. From a character-level toy to a 40M-parameter model with its own BPE tokenizer and a frozen benchmark it climbed from 17% to 60.75%.

journey.title: Now
journey.detail: Preparing for JEE-Mains while keeping the builder's flame alive. College next year; the projects continue.

achievements.title: Trained a language model from scratch — 17% → 60.75%
achievements.detail: Built Aizen end to end in PyTorch and raised it from 17% to 60.75% on a frozen 400-question benchmark across eight documented phases — ending with a 40M-parameter model where every category hit an all-time high. No pretrained weights, no cloud GPUs — every run on a MacBook.

achievements.title: Wrote a BPE tokenizer from scratch
achievements.detail: No libraries: pair counting, merges, a 4096-token vocabulary, with digits kept whole so arithmetic wouldn't break. Swapping it in lifted the same-size model from 28.75% to 35.75% — the same parameters, better spent.

achievements.title: Ran the experiments honestly
achievements.detail: Froze the benchmark before the first improvement and never tuned against it. One training run per approved experiment. Set a hard 30–50M parameter cap up front and finished at 40M, so every gain had to come from data and method — and the one time scale was the variable, it was the only variable changed.

achievements.title: Built Gyan OS
achievements.detail: This portfolio is a working desktop operating system in the browser — window manager, dock, seven apps, global search, live wallpapers, and a real connection to my own language model.

achievements.title: Shipped 11 projects while teaching myself
achievements.detail: Games, study tools, an AR experiment, a 3D AI assistant — each one finished and published, self-taught, alongside school.
